typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT  	 \'TLR\' AS [Record Type] 	,CAST(REPLACE(STR(?,10), SPACE(1), \'0\') AS CHAR(10)) AS [Detail Record Count] 	,\'000000\' + CAST(? AS CHAR(8)) + CAST(? AS CHAR(6)) AS [Control Number] 	,SPACE(4543) AS [Filler1] 	,SPACE(4543) AS [Filler2] 	,\'X\' AS [End of Record Indicator]',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		Filler1 as string,
		Control_Number as string,
		Filler2 as string,
		Detail_Record_Count as string,
		Record_Type as string,
		End_of_Record_Indicator as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Filler1,
		Control_Number = {Control Number},
		Filler2,
		Detail_Record_Count = {Detail Record Count},
		Record_Type = {Record Type},
		End_of_Record_Indicator = {End of Record Indicator})) ~> FlatFileDestination
